lines.trans: Step back and admire Tin One, glazed in person by the owner of the inn!

words.gloss: give; take (dad medio paso = take half a step)

lines.trans: You measured two small teaspoons of lemon juice with sugar, right, Ernesto?
Two big soup ladles of pure lemon juice for an unforgettable summer flavour!
Ernesto! Soup ladles?! Where were your reading glasses when you looked at the spoon?!
Wait, too late, Mateo already put a full forkful into his mouth!
Give me one quiet moment while my cheeks try to return to their place.
Here is a glass of cold water, Mateo: what is your official pencil score?

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: The almond crumb is tender, the berries are sweet, and the top polishes brass.
It polishes brass?! A refreshing citrus touch deserves at least seven points!
I am writing down a three out of ten, plus a warning sign for the front desk.
Thank you for your bravery, judge; Ernesto is officially retired from spoon duty!
Just wait until you taste how crunchy Tomas made Tin Number Two!
Step back and admire Tin One, glazed in person by the owner of the inn!

words.gloss: give; take (dad medio paso = take half a step)

Two big soup ladles of pure lemon juice for an unforgettable summer flavour!
Ernesto! Soup ladles?! Where were your reading glasses when you looked at the spoon?!
Wait, too late, Mateo already put a full forkful into his mouth!
Give me one quiet moment while my cheeks try to return to their place.
Here is a glass of cold water, Mateo: what is your official pencil score?

It polishes brass?! A refreshing citrus touch deserves at least seven points!
I am writing down a three out of ten, plus a warning sign for the front desk.
Thank you for your bravery, judge; Ernesto is officially retired from spoon duty!
Just wait until you taste how crunchy Tomas made Tin Number Two!
Step back and admire Tin One, glazed in person by the owner of the inn!

Two big soup ladles of pure lemon juice for an unforgettable summer flavour!
Ernesto! Soup ladles?! Where were your reading glasses when you looked at the spoon?!
Wait, too late, Mateo already put a full forkful into his mouth!
Give me one quiet moment while my cheeks try to return to their place.

lines.trans: The almond crumb is tender, the berries are sweet, and the top polishes brass.
It polishes brass?! A refreshing citrus touch deserves at least seven points!
I am writing down a three out of ten, plus a warning sign for the front desk.
Thank you for your bravery, judge; Ernesto is officially retired from spoon duty!
Just wait until you taste how crunchy Tomas made Tin Number Two!
Good afternoon!

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb meaning to look at with wonder or respect.

examples.text: Los vecinos se detuvieron en el patio para admirar los farolillos.
examples.trans: The neighbours stopped in the courtyard to admire the lanterns.

examples.text: Admiro mucho la paciencia con la que Mateo arregla cada reloj.
examples.trans: I greatly admire the patience with which Mateo fixes every clock.

meanings.note: Feminine noun that takes el in the singular before stressed initial /a/ (el agua fría).

examples.text: Quiero un vaso de agua fría.
examples.trans: I want a glass of cold water.

examples.text: El agua de la ducha sale caliente.
examples.trans: The shower water comes out hot.

meanings.note: Classic Mediterranean baking ingredient in tarts and biscuits.

examples.text: Rocío hornea galletas crujientes de almendra y limón.
examples.trans: Rocio bakes crunchy almond and lemon biscuits.

examples.text: Tostamos las almendras cinco minutos en el horno.
examples.trans: We toast the almonds for five minutes in the oven.

meanings.note: Everyday word in Spain for writing down a note or phone number.

examples.text: Apunto la dirección en un papel.
examples.trans: I jot down the address on a piece of paper.

examples.text: ¿Apuntaste el nombre del cliente?
examples.trans: Did you write down the guest's name?

meanings.note: Right where the speaker is.

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave.
examples.trans: Here is your key.

examples.text: Nos sentamos aquí bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We sit right here under the tree.

meanings.note: Opposite of abajo.

examples.text: Las habitaciones están arriba.
examples.trans: The bedrooms are upstairs.

examples.text: Mira arriba hacia el balcón.
examples.trans: Look up toward the balcony.

meanings.note: Indicates position or movement toward the rear.

examples.text: Da un paso atrás, por favor.
examples.trans: Take one step back, please.

examples.text: Hombros atrás y respira hondo.
examples.trans: Shoulders back and breathe deeply.

meanings.note: Written notice or spoken heads-up.

examples.text: El aviso está aquí.
examples.trans: The notice is here.

examples.text: Vemos los avisos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the notices from the door.

meanings.note: Commonly masculine (sin azúcar = without sugar).

examples.text: El azúcar es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The sugar is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el azúcar.
examples.trans: We talk about the sugar.

meanings.note: General botanical and culinary word for small fleshy berries (bayas rojas = red berries).

examples.text: Tomás lavó dos cestas llenas de bayas rojas maduras.
examples.trans: Tomas washed two baskets full of ripe red berries.

examples.text: Las bayas dulces combinan muy bien con la masa de almendra.
examples.trans: Sweet berries pair very well with the almond batter.

meanings.note: Also denotes the pouring lip or opening of a jug or tunnel.

examples.text: La boca está aquí.
examples.trans: The mouth is here.

examples.text: Vemos las bocas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the mouths from the door.

meanings.note: Shortens to buen before masculine singular nouns (buen viaje); ¡Buenos días! = Good morning!

examples.text: ¡Buenos días a todos!
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone!

examples.text: Hace muy buen tiempo hoy.
examples.trans: The weather is very nice today.

meanings.note: Shopfront sign or notice board.

examples.text: El cartel está aquí.
examples.trans: The sign is here.

examples.text: Vemos los carteles desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the signs from the door.

meanings.note: Combines with mí/ti to form conmigo ('with me') and contigo ('with you').

examples.text: Tomo café con leche caliente.
examples.trans: I take coffee with hot milk.

examples.text: Habla con calma, por favor.
examples.trans: Speak calmly, please.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine.

examples.text: Es una pieza crujiente.
examples.trans: It is a crispy piece.

examples.text: ¡Hornea muchas esquinas crujientes, cariño!
examples.trans: Bake plenty of corner pieces, my dear!

meanings.note: Unaccented in statements and time clauses (interrogative: cuándo).

examples.text: Avísame cuando llegue el taxi.
examples.trans: Let me know when the taxi arrives.

examples.text: Cuando llueve, huele a tierra mojada.
examples.trans: When it rains, it smells like wet earth.

meanings.note: Table or soup spoon; cucharita is a teaspoon.

examples.text: Pon una cuchara limpia junto a cada cuenco.
examples.trans: Set a clean spoon beside each bowl.

examples.text: Prueba la sopa de lentejas con esta cuchara.
examples.trans: Taste the lentil soup with this spoon.

meanings.note: Diminutive of cucharada ('spoonful / tablespoonful'), standard in recipes for a teaspoon measure.

examples.text: Añade solo dos cucharaditas de zumo de limón al glaseado.
examples.trans: Add only two teaspoons of lemon juice to the glaze.

examples.text: Puse media cucharadita de miel en mi taza de té de menta.
examples.trans: I put half a teaspoon of honey in my cup of mint tea.

meanings.note: Augmentative of cuchara ('spoon') with -ón, denoting a deep kitchen ladle.

examples.text: ¡Ernesto confundió la cuchara pequeña con el cucharón de la sopa!
examples.trans: Ernesto mistook the small spoon for the soup ladle!

examples.text: Rocío sirvió el caldo caliente con un cucharón de plata.
examples.trans: Rocio served the hot broth with a silver ladle.

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun choosing from options (plural: cuáles).

examples.text: Hay dos calles: ¿cuál cojo?
examples.trans: There are two streets: which one do I take?

examples.text: ¿Cuál es tu taza de té?
examples.trans: Which one is your teacup?

meanings.note: Describes the bright, tangy aroma or flavour of lemons, oranges, and limes.

examples.text: Un toque cítrico de limón alegra cualquier postre de verano.
examples.trans: A citrus touch of lemon brightens any summer dessert.

examples.text: Me encanta el aroma cítrico de las flores del limonero en mayo.
examples.trans: I love the citrusy scent of the lemon tree blossoms in May.

dar.gloss: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)

meanings.en: to give; to face onto (dar a); to strike (the hour)
meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg doy and preterite di/dio; dar las doce = strike twelve.

examples.text: La ventana da al patio soleado.
examples.trans: The window looks out onto the sunny courtyard.

examples.text: El reloj acaba de dar las doce.
examples.trans: The clock has just struck twelve.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Dejar de + infinitive means 'to stop doing something'.

examples.text: Dejo las llaves en el mostrador.
examples.trans: I leave the keys on the counter.

examples.text: Déjame ayudarte con esa caja.
examples.trans: Let me help you with that box.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition de + masculine article el.

examples.text: El bizcocho acaba de salir del horno.
examples.trans: The cake just came out of the oven.

examples.text: Soy vecino del barrio.
examples.trans: I am a neighbour from the quarter.

demasiado.gloss: too much; too many; too (as adv)

meanings.en: too much; too many; too (as adv)
meanings.note: Agrees as a determiner before a noun (demasiado tiempo); invariable as an adverb before an adjective.

examples.text: Tres años era demasiado tiempo.
examples.trans: Three years was too much time.

examples.text: No camines demasiado rápido.
examples.trans: Do not walk too fast.

meanings.note: Diez sobre diez = ten out of ten.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para empezar.
examples.trans: There are ten minutes left before starting.

examples.text: Su recepción merece un diez.
examples.trans: Your front desk deserves a ten.

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Feminine: la dueña.

examples.text: El dueño está aquí.
examples.trans: The owner is here.

examples.text: Vemos los dueños desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the owners from the door.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine; los dulces = sweets/pastries.

examples.text: Es una pieza dulce.
examples.trans: It is a sweet piece.

examples.text: ¿Podemos servir mantequilla salada con mermelada dulce de fresa?
examples.trans: Can we serve salted butter with sweet strawberry jam?

meanings.note: Interrogative adverb with written accent.

examples.text: Mira dónde señala con el lápiz.
examples.trans: Look where he is pointing with his pencil.

examples.text: ¿Dónde van las cucharillas y las servilletas?
examples.trans: Where do the teaspoons and the napkins go?

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: As a masculine noun (el frío), means 'the cold'.

examples.text: Es una pieza fría.
examples.trans: It is a cold piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

meanings.note: Plural-only feminine noun in Spain: las gafas.

examples.text: ¿Dónde he dejado mis gafas?
examples.trans: Where did I leave my glasses?

examples.text: Lleva unas gafas redondas.
examples.trans: He wears round glasses.

meanings.note: Sweet lemon or sugar glaze.

examples.text: El glaseado es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The glaze is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el glaseado.
examples.trans: We talk about the glaze.

meanings.note: Gracias por + noun/infinitive expresses 'thank you for...'.

examples.text: ¡Muchas gracias por su ayuda!
examples.trans: Thank you very much for your help!

examples.text: Gracias por venir hoy.
examples.trans: Thank you for coming today.

grande.gloss: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)

meanings.en: big; large; great (gran before sg noun)
meanings.note: Shortens to gran before any singular noun (un gran libro, una gran idea).

examples.text: Tenemos una mesa grande en el patio.
examples.trans: We have a big table in the courtyard.

examples.text: Es una gran noticia para todos.
examples.trans: It is great news for everyone.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Built from in- ('un-') + olvidar ('to forget') + -ble.

examples.text: Aquella fiesta bajo los farolillos del patio fue una noche inolvidable.
examples.trans: That party under the courtyard lanterns was an unforgettable night.

examples.text: El zumo puro de limón le dio a la tarta un sabor inolvidable.
examples.trans: Pure lemon juice gave the cake an unforgettable flavour.

meanings.note: Followed directly by an infinitive (intenté sonreír).

examples.text: Intento aprender diez palabras al día.
examples.trans: I try to learn ten words a day.

examples.text: Intenté llamarte ayer por la tarde.
examples.trans: I tried calling you yesterday afternoon.

meanings.note: Used with estar when stating someone is retired (está jubilado) or directly after a profession (un cartógrafo jubilado); also used as a noun.

examples.text: El cartógrafo jubilado envió una postal desde la costa.
examples.trans: The retired mapmaker sent a postcard from the coast.

examples.text: Mi tío está jubilado y pasea cada mañana por el parque.
examples.trans: My uncle is retired and walks through the park every morning.

meanings.note: Plural changes -z to -ces (los jueces); common gender el/la juez (or feminine la jueza).

examples.text: Mateo sirvió hoy como nuestro juez principal en la prueba de tartas.
examples.trans: Mateo served today as our chief judge in the cake tasting.

examples.text: Los tres jueces aplaudieron cuando probaron el último plato.
examples.trans: All three judges applauded when they tasted the final dish.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Yellow copper-zinc alloy used for keys, lamps, and valves.

examples.text: El latón es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The brass is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el latón.
examples.trans: We talk about the brass.

meanings.note: Preterite 3rd sg/pl spells y: leyó, leyeron; past participle leído.

examples.text: Leo el periódico con el primer café.
examples.trans: I read the newspaper with my first coffee.

examples.text: Anoche leímos toda la carta juntos.
examples.trans: Last night we read the whole letter together.

meanings.note: Opposite of sucio (dirty).

examples.text: Es una pieza limpia.
examples.trans: It is a clean piece.

examples.text: Aquí tiene un paño limpio y agua fría, Ernesto.
examples.trans: Here is a clean cloth and cold water, Ernesto.

meanings.note: Plural limones.

examples.text: El limón está aquí.
examples.trans: The lemon is here.

examples.text: Vemos los limones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the lemons from the door.

meanings.note: Opposite of vacío (empty).

examples.text: Es una pieza llena.
examples.trans: It is a full piece.

examples.text: Vaya... ¿con esta lluvia? Todos los hoteles cerca de la estación parecían llenos.
examples.trans: Oh dear... in this rain? Every hotel near the station looked full.

llevar.gloss: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)

meanings.en: to carry; to wear; to take; to spend (time)
meanings.note: Versatile verb for carrying items, wearing clothes/glasses, or duration.

examples.text: Llevo dos tazas calientes al jardín.
examples.trans: I carry two hot cups to the garden.

examples.text: Hoy lleva un abrigo gris oscuro.
examples.trans: Today he is wearing a dark grey coat.

lo.gloss: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)

meanings.en: it / him (direct object); the (neuter before adj/que)
meanings.note: Direct object pronoun before verbs (lo veo), and neuter article in lo que ('what') or lo mejor ('the best').

examples.text: Ya lo veo encima del estante.
examples.trans: I see it now on the shelf.

examples.text: Lo mejor del patio es la calma.
examples.trans: The best part of the courtyard is the calm.

meanings.note: Plural los lápices; a lápiz = in pencil.

examples.text: El lápiz está aquí.
examples.trans: The pencil is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lápices desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the pencils from the door.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> i: mido, midió).

examples.text: Mido el ancho de la mesa nueva.
examples.trans: I measure the width of the new table.

examples.text: El carpintero midió la tabla dos veces.
examples.trans: The carpenter measured the plank twice.

meanings.note: Everyday word for a person's cheek (las mejillas).

examples.text: El limón estaba tan ácido que a Mateo se le encogieron las mejillas.
examples.trans: The lemon was so tart that Mateo's cheeks puckered up.

examples.text: Su abuela le dio dos besos cariñosos en las mejillas al llegar.
examples.trans: Her grandmother gave her two warm kisses on the cheeks when she arrived.

meanings.note: Por lo menos = at least; echar de menos = to miss; a menos que = unless.

examples.text: Son las ocho menos diez.
examples.trans: It is ten to eight.

examples.text: Por lo menos ya no llueve.
examples.trans: At least it is no longer raining.

meanings.note: Irregular 1st sg merezco.

examples.text: Este café merece cinco estrellas.
examples.trans: This coffee deserves five stars.

examples.text: Después de correr, mereces un descanso.
examples.trans: After running, you deserve a rest.

meanings.note: Plural mis (mi llave / mis llaves); unaccented, distinct from pronoun mí.

examples.text: Mi maleta es azul marino.
examples.trans: My suitcase is navy blue.

examples.text: Mis apuntes están en el bolsillo.
examples.trans: My notes are in my pocket.

meanings.note: Links two simultaneous actions.

examples.text: Espera aquí mientras abro la puerta.
examples.trans: Wait here while I open the door.

examples.text: Preparo el té mientras sale el pan.
examples.trans: I make the tea while the bread comes out.

meanings.note: Singular la miga refers to a single crumb or the soft interior of a loaf (opposite of la corteza); plural las migas means crumbs.

examples.text: La hogaza recién hecha tiene la corteza crujiente y la miga tierna.
examples.trans: The freshly baked loaf has a crisp crust and a tender crumb.

examples.text: Le gustó tanto la tarta de limón que no dejó ni una miga.
examples.trans: She liked the lemon tart so much that she did not leave a single crumb.

mirar.gloss: to look; to look at; to watch

meanings.en: to look; to look at; to watch
meanings.note: Needs no preposition for 'at' (mira el reloj = look at the clock).

examples.text: Mira qué sol hace esta mañana.
examples.trans: Look how sunny it is this morning.

examples.text: Miramos el mapa antes de salir.
examples.trans: We look at the map before going out.

meanings.note: In baking, el molde is a cake tin or baking pan; letra de molde means block/printed letters.

examples.text: Repartimos la masa de almendra en tres moldes redondos pequeños.
examples.trans: We divided the almond batter across three small round baking tins.

examples.text: Unta el molde con un poco de mantequilla antes de meterlo al horno.
examples.trans: Grease the baking tin with a little butter before putting it in the oven.

meanings.note: De momento = for now.

examples.text: El momento está aquí.
examples.trans: The moment is here.

examples.text: Vemos los momentos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the moments from the door.

meanings.note: Reception desk or shop counter.

examples.text: El mostrador está aquí.
examples.trans: The counter is here.

examples.text: Vemos los mostradores desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the counters from the door.

meanings.note: Accented más means 'more / most'; de más = extra.

examples.text: ¿Quiere un poco más de té?
examples.trans: Would you like a little more tea?

examples.text: Es la habitación más tranquila.
examples.trans: It is the quietest room.

meanings.note: Covers jotted notes, musical notes, and review scores.

examples.text: La nota está aquí.
examples.trans: The note is here.

examples.text: Vemos las notas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the notes from the door.

meanings.note: Written after street names in Spanish addresses (Calle Mayor número ocho).

examples.text: El número está aquí.
examples.trans: The number is here.

examples.text: Vemos los números desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the numbers from the door.

meanings.note: Same form for masculine and feminine singular; plural oficiales.

examples.text: Mañana recibimos la carta oficial del ayuntamiento.
examples.trans: Tomorrow we receive the official letter from City Hall.

examples.text: Hoy es la apertura oficial de nuestra sala de té.
examples.trans: Today is the official opening of our tea room.

meanings.note: Formed by adding -mente to the adjective oficial.

examples.text: Ernesto queda oficialmente jubilado del turno de cucharas en la cocina.
examples.trans: Ernesto is officially retired from spoon duty in the kitchen.

examples.text: La fiesta del treinta aniversario empieza oficialmente a las seis.
examples.trans: The thirtieth-anniversary party officially begins at six o'clock.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Feminine noun: la mejor parte.

examples.text: La parte está aquí.
examples.trans: The part is here.

examples.text: Vemos las partes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the parts from the door.

meanings.note: Oír pasos = to hear footsteps.

examples.text: El paso está aquí.
examples.trans: The footstep is here.

examples.text: Vemos los pasos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the footsteps from the door.

meanings.note: Hermano pequeño = younger brother; de pequeño = as a child.

examples.text: Es una pieza pequeña.
examples.trans: It is a small piece.

examples.text: Hay una pequeña tarjeta de cartón atada al asa.
examples.trans: There is a small cardboard card tied to the handle.

meanings.note: Always feminine (una persona amable) regardless of who it refers to.

examples.text: La persona está aquí.
examples.trans: The person is here.

examples.text: Vemos las personas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the persons from the door.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: Charming small inn with rooms around a courtyard.

examples.text: La posada está aquí.
examples.trans: The inn is here.

examples.text: Vemos las posadas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the inns from the door.

probar.gloss: to try; to taste; to test

meanings.en: to try; to taste; to test
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: pruebo).

examples.text: Prueba este pan con aceite de oliva.
examples.trans: Try this bread with olive oil.

examples.text: Ayer probamos la mermelada de manzana.
examples.trans: Yesterday we tasted the apple jam.

punto.gloss: dot; point (en punto = on the dot; a punto de = about to)

meanings.en: dot; point (en punto = on the dot; a punto de = about to)
meanings.note: A las nueve en punto = at nine o'clock sharp.

examples.text: El punto está aquí.
examples.trans: The dot is here.

examples.text: Vemos los puntos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the dots from the door.

meanings.note: Pura suerte = pure luck.

examples.text: Es una pieza pura.
examples.trans: It is a pure piece.

examples.text: Por puro accidente
examples.trans: By complete accident

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

quedar.gloss: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)

meanings.en: to remain / be left; to suit; to meet up (Spain); to stay (quedarse)
meanings.note: Versatile verb: quedan dos ('two left'), le queda bien ('suits you'), quedar al mediodía ('meet at noon'), quedarse ('stay').

examples.text: Solo quedan dos habitaciones libres.
examples.trans: Only two vacant rooms are left.

examples.text: Esa chaqueta te queda muy bien.
examples.trans: That jacket suits you very well.

meanings.note: En recepción = at the front desk.

examples.text: La recepción está aquí.
examples.trans: The front desk is here.

examples.text: Vemos las recepciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the front desks from the door.

meanings.note: Invariable for masculine/feminine; describes a cool drink, citrus flavour, or breeze.

examples.text: El toque cítrico de limón es muy refrescante en una tarde de calor.
examples.trans: The citrus touch of lemon is very refreshing on a warm afternoon.

examples.text: Preparamos una jarra grande de té frío con menta refrescante.
examples.trans: We made a big pitcher of iced tea with refreshing mint.

meanings.note: Standard culinary noun for the flavour of food or drink.

examples.text: Esta tarde haremos la gran prueba de sabor de los tres glaseados.
examples.trans: This afternoon we will hold the great taste test of the three glazes.

examples.text: La miel de flores le da un sabor suave y redondo a la tarta.
examples.trans: Wildflower honey gives the cake a smooth, rounded flavour.

se.gloss: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one

meanings.en: himself / herself / yourself / themselves; impersonal one
meanings.note: Reflexive, reciprocal, passive/impersonal pronoun, and indirect object le/les before lo/la.

examples.text: La puerta se abre despacio.
examples.trans: The door opens slowly.

examples.text: Aquí se oye el canto de los pájaros.
examples.trans: Here you can hear the birds singing.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Las siete y cuarto = seven fifteen.

examples.text: La habitación siete mira al patio.
examples.trans: Room seven overlooks the courtyard.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las siete y media.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at seven thirty.

meanings.note: En silencio = quietly.

examples.text: El silencio es muy importante aquí.
examples.trans: The silence is very important here.

examples.text: Hablamos sobre el silencio.
examples.trans: We talk about the silence.

meanings.note: Everyday Peninsula favourite for 'place' or 'seat'.

examples.text: El sitio está aquí.
examples.trans: The place is here.

examples.text: Vemos los sitios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the place from the door.

sobre.gloss: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)

meanings.en: on; upon; about; out of (nueve sobre diez)
meanings.note: Sobre todo = above all / mostly; also a homograph noun el sobre ('envelope').

examples.text: Deja la llave sobre el mostrador.
examples.trans: Leave the key on the counter.

examples.text: Sacó nueve sobre diez en la prueba.
examples.trans: She scored nine out of ten on the test.

meanings.note: Hecho una sopa = soaked through.

examples.text: La sopa está aquí.
examples.trans: The soup is here.

examples.text: Vemos las sopas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the soups from the door.

su.gloss: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)

meanings.en: his; her; its; their; your (polite usted/ustedes)
meanings.note: Plural sus (su maleta / sus maletas).

examples.text: Aquí tiene su llave, señora.
examples.trans: Here is your key, madam.

examples.text: Sus habitaciones están en la primera planta.
examples.trans: Your rooms are on the first floor.

meanings.note: Por la tarde = in the afternoon; ¡Buenas tardes! = Good afternoon!; llegar tarde = arrive late.

examples.text: ¡Buenas tardes! ¿Tienen una habitación libre?
examples.trans: Good afternoon! Do you have a room free?

examples.text: Perdón por llegar un poco tarde.
examples.trans: Sorry for arriving a little late.

meanings.note: Standard word for an eating fork (tenedor de postre = dessert fork).

examples.text: Mateo se llevó un tenedor lleno de tarta tibia a la boca.
examples.trans: Mateo put a forkful of warm cake into his mouth.

examples.text: Coloca el tenedor a la izquierda del plato y el cuchillo a la derecha.
examples.trans: Place the fork to the left of the plate and the knife to the right.

tener.gloss: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)

meanings.en: to have; to have to (tener que + inf)
meanings.note: Used in idioms: tener hambre/frío/miedo/prisa/razón; tener que = must.

examples.text: Tenemos ocho habitaciones tranquilas.
examples.trans: We have eight quiet rooms.

examples.text: Tengo que cerrar la ventana ahora.
examples.trans: I have to close the window now.

meanings.note: In Spain, pan tierno is freshly baked bread with a soft crumb.

examples.text: Las hogazas salen tiernas por dentro y muy crujientes.
examples.trans: The loaves come out soft inside and very crusty.

examples.text: Las zanahorias tiernas dan un dulzor suave al caldo.
examples.trans: Tender young carrots give a gentle sweetness to the broth.

tocar.gloss: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)

meanings.en: to touch; to ring (a bell); to play (an instrument)
meanings.note: Preterite 1st sg spells c -> qu: toqué.

examples.text: Alguien acaba de tocar el timbre.
examples.trans: Someone just rang the bell.

examples.text: De niño tocaba el piano los viernes.
examples.trans: As a boy he played the piano on Fridays.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Ponemos tres mesas bajo el árbol.
examples.trans: We set three tables under the tree.

examples.text: Empieza con tres frases cortas.
examples.trans: Start with three short sentences.

meanings.note: Unaccented possessive (tu llave / tus llaves), distinct from accented pronoun tú.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está tu caja de herramientas?
examples.trans: Where is your toolbox?

examples.text: Reconocí tu letra enseguida.
examples.trans: I recognized your handwriting right away.

meanings.note: Used for one's turn in a game or queue (es tu turno) and a work shift (turno de mañana).

examples.text: Ernesto queda oficialmente jubilado del turno de cucharas en la cocina.
examples.trans: Ernesto is officially retired from spoon duty in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ahora es el turno de Carmen para elegir la música de la tarde.
examples.trans: Now it is Carmen's turn to choose the afternoon music.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Shortens to un before masculine singular nouns.

examples.text: Toma uno recién salido del horno.
examples.trans: Take one fresh out of the oven.

examples.text: Contamos del uno al ocho.
examples.trans: We count from one to eight.

meanings.note: Means both 'courage, bravery' in facing a challenge and 'value, worth'.

examples.text: ¡Gracias por tu valor al probar los tres moldes, señor juez!
examples.trans: Thank you for your bravery in testing all three tins, Mr Judge!

examples.text: Este libro antiguo de recetas familiares tiene un gran valor para nosotros.
examples.trans: This old family recipe book has great value for us.

meanings.note: Un vaso de agua = a glass of water.

examples.text: El vaso está aquí.
examples.trans: The drinking glass is here.

examples.text: Vemos los vasos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the drinking glasss from the door.

meanings.note: Irregular: veo, vi, visto.

examples.text: Desde aquí veo el puente de piedra.
examples.trans: From here I see the stone bridge.

examples.text: ¡Nos vemos luego en el patio!
examples.trans: See you later in the courtyard!

meanings.note: El verano que viene = next summer.

examples.text: El verano está aquí.
examples.trans: The summer is here.

examples.text: Vemos los veranos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the summers from the door.

meanings.note: La verdad = honestly / the truth.

examples.text: La verdad está aquí.
examples.trans: The truth is here.

examples.text: Vemos las verdades desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the truths from the door.

volver.gloss: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)

meanings.en: to return; to come back; to do again (volver a + inf)
meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: vuelvo), past participle vuelto; volverse + adj = become.

examples.text: Vuelvo en cinco minutos.
examples.trans: I will be back in five minutes.

examples.text: Volvió a sonreír enseguida.
examples.trans: He smiled again right away.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: ¡Ya está! = All done!; ya no = no longer.

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is already ready.

examples.text: ¡Ya voy con las llaves!
examples.trans: Coming right now with the keys!

meanings.note: Standard word in Spain for fruit juice (zumo de naranja).

examples.text: El zumo está aquí.
examples.trans: The juice is here.

examples.text: Vemos los zumos desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the juices from the door.
